configurations.name: kittyclaw-web-debug
runtimeArgs: $env:KITTYCLAW_DATA_DIR = "$env:APPDATA\KittyClaw-debug"; dotnet build KittyClaw.ClaudeMock -v q | Out-Null; $env:KITTYCLAW_CLAUDE_BIN = (Resolve-Path 'KittyClaw.ClaudeMock\bin\Debug\net10.0\claude.exe').Path; $env:KITTYCLAW_GROK_BIN = $env:KITTYCLAW_CLAUDE_BIN; $env:ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT = 'Development'; dotnet run --project KittyClaw.Web --no-launch-profile --urls http://localhost:5232
